title: Signal and Horizon
author: Vesper Ashgrove
blurb: Marguerite Eastwick, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
